tree: Improve design to optimize memory usage

Move the free list out of the inode pages into a separate array so
unused pages can be returned to the kernel. Track free counts per
batch and reclaim full batches with MADV_DONTNEED. Also cap the
libgit2 object cache and free blobs after writing to memfd.

Signed-off-by: Fernando Gonzalez <fernando.gonzalez@suse.com>

git-fs: add file metadata to stat output

Populate timestamp from git commit times.
Also Remove blob loading from lookup_tree so that
stat only reads ODB headers, not full objects.

tests/: Add parallel tests

git-fs: fix readdirplus bugs

Some bugs catched by the integration tests:
- Readdir cursor not persisting across calls.
- Commit children reporting zero size.
- Wrong tag expectation in integration test.

Signed-off-by: Fernando Gonzalez <fernando.gonzalez@suse.com>

git-fs: Add --foreground option

Allow the user to run git-fs as a daemon or in the
foreground. Useful also for the integration tests.

Signed-off-by: Fernando Gonzalez <fernando.gonzalez@suse.com>

git-fs: Fix backing_id race condition

The passthrough backing_id was stored on the inode,
so concurrent opens of the same file overwrote each other.
Move it to a per-handle struct in fi->fh.

git-fs: Replace readdir with readdirplus

readdirplus is the default in modern kernels, and
performance wise much faster than readdir.

git-fs: Add buffered read fallback

If FUSE passthrough is not avaiable, use fuse_reply_data

git-fs: Add forget callbacks and child list rebuild on opendir

Implement gitfs_forget and gitfs_forget_multi. Call tree_ref on
each lookup reply. On opendir, swap out the child list, free the
previous retired list, and rebuild from git. Restore the old list
on update failure. Call tree_destroy on shutdown.

Signed-off-by: Fernando Gonzalez <fernando.gonzalez@suse.com>

Inode: fix git object ownership and leaks

Add set_obj helper that frees the previous object before replacing
it. Use git_object_dup for T_HASH and T_MSG so each inode owns its
reference. Extract resolve_commit to share the switch between
update_commit and lookup_commit. Free git_tree_entry in lookup_tree.

Signed-off-by: Fernando Gonzalez <fernando.gonzalez@suse.com>

tree: lock-free inode pool

Add tree_ref, tree_forget, free_retired, and tree_destroy.
Replace fixed calloc pool with mmap-backed demand-paged pool.
Free list uses compare-and-swap for push/pop. Pool grows in
batches when empty. Nodes are freed on forget (name, git object)
and reclaimed on the next opendir via free_retired. Readers skip
deleted nodes in the circular sibling list.

Signed-off-by: Fernando Gonzalez <fernando.gonzalez@suse.com>

Integrate with libgit2

This integration takes special consideration with libfuse's
thread pool. Each thread needs to safely access the repository
data provided by libgit2 at runtime. This implementation
stores that information in the TLS, which gets initialized
lazily for each thread.
